name: comp-233

frames.best_why: The panel is open with the search field and nine icon-and-count rows, no cursor inside the list.

tagline: A service picker whose rows pair a small icon with a running count.
summary: A searchable category picker where every row shows an icon, a service name and a right-aligned total. Choosing a row puts its icon and name into the closed trigger.
appearance: A small label sits above a wide rounded trigger reading Select service category with a chevron. Opened, a compact dark panel holds a search field and tight rows of a tiny grey icon, a category name and a far-right number.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger opens the panel; typing filters the rows by name, and picking one closes it and shows that icon plus label in the trigger. The clip filters to datab and settles on Database Systems.
demo_content: Analytics Platform 2,451; AI Services 1,832; Database Systems 1,654; Compute Resources 943 and similar categories
search_phrases: pick a service category from a list
choose a resource type with numbers
list of categories with item counts
use_when: When categories are many and each carries a count that helps people choose by volume.
avoid_when: The counts are fixed numbers in the file, so they drift from any real total unless wired to data.
customise: The ten categories, their icons and counts form an array in the file; edit or replace it. The field label, search placeholder and trigger width are written in the same file.
weight_why: Ten short rows with inline icons in a popup and one brief open animation.

a11y.note: The trigger is a labelled combobox and filtering works from the keyboard; each count is plain text in the row, read after the category name.

issues: The counts look like live totals but are fixed numbers written in the file.
The field label is the demo phrase Options with icon and number, not a real field name.
polish_why: Even rows and useful counts; plain styling and nothing marks the numbers as static.
